description.value: One Under is a 5,000-square-foot urban golf club, eatery, and bar centrally set in Vancouver's Financial District, featuring six HD Golf simulation bays alongside a full kitchen and craft cocktail bar. Guests can play virtual rounds on world-famous courses or compete in long-drive contests, then settle in for chef-crafted pizzas, sandwiches, and rotating local craft beers. The venue welcomes non-golfers as well, making it a lively spot for a meal or drinks in the heart of downtown.
